description_excerpt: Job Description Main responsibilities • Be the go-to person for day-to-day procurement administration activities across all direct & indirect categories and MRO. • Support procurement team with onboarding process of new suppliers. • Support to local procurement and internal stakeholders to maintain supplier & contract database, create Purchase Order (PO). • Set up meetings and aligned agenda with procurement team. • Contract and PO compliance: Drive and ensure compliance with local procurement process with stakeholders. • Other admin supportive tasks to be discussed and aligned according to…
